# Commands Reference (auto-generated — v0.2.3)

> **Source of truth**: this file is generated by `scripts/build-commands-doc.ts`. Do not edit by hand — change the command schema (`src/abap_cli/commands/*.ts`, `src/abap_cli/flows/setup/command-schemas.ts`) and run the generator.

Every command supports the global `--json` option for structured output (Agent-First design). Success output is written to **stdout**, errors to **stderr**; both follow the same shape when `--json` is used. The unified machine-readable envelope contract lives at `src/abap_cli/output/cli-output.schema.json` (JSON Schema draft-07) and is enforced by `test/unit/envelope-schema.test.ts` for every registered command.

## Global Options

```
-V, --version        output the version number
--json               Emit the unified JSON envelope (compact; default for agents)
--pretty-json        Emit the unified JSON envelope with 2-space indentation
-h, --help           display help for command
```

## JSON Output Contract

Machine-readable contract for every `abap <cmd> --json` response. Success envelopes go to stdout only; failure envelopes go to stderr only; stdout stays empty on any failure path. exit code maps to error.category (output/exit-codes.ts). Enforced by test/unit/envelope-schema.test.ts for every registered command.

Structured failure. `code` is the literal ErrorCode; `category` drives the exit code. Derived enums are regenerated by `npm run build-schema`. Extension failures always use dedicated EXTENSION_* codes and never override built-in codes.

Every `--json` envelope carries a `meta` block (`command`, `version`, `timestamp`, `durationMs`, `warnings`). `--pretty-json` emits the same shape with 2-space indentation (human/agent readability); `--json` is compact (token-efficient). The `--schema` mode (`abap <cmd> --schema`) returns a reduced `meta` containing only `command` / `version` / `durationMs` — no `timestamp` / `warnings` — for stable agent introspection.

```jsonc
// Success (stdout)
{ "status": "success", "meta": { "command": "abap pull", "version": "0.2.3", "timestamp": "...", "durationMs": 42, "warnings": [] }, "data": { ... } }

// Failure (stderr — stdout is empty)
{ "status": "error", "meta": { ... }, "error": { "code": "...", "category": "...", "message": "...", "nextSteps": [...], ... } }
```

Warnings never enter the error envelope: non-fatal warnings (e.g. a deprecated option, or a push whose lock could not be released) appear as structured `meta.warnings` entries (or `Warning: …` stderr lines in human mode) and never change the exit code.

Exit codes (stable contract, only additive across versions): `0` success, `1` unknown/unmapped failure (generic fallback), `2` usage, `3` config, `4` TLS, `5` auth, `6` SAP error, `7` validation, `8` not-found, `9` locked; `>=10` reserved. `error.category` in the JSON always maps 1:1 to the exit code. See the common-errors help block on every command for the full table.

## Commands

This generator emits **19** commands in a stable display order. New commands appear automatically once a schema is registered with `commandSchemas` (or a per-command `SCHEMA` constant) — see the generator source for the canonical list.

## `abap init` _(local)_

Initialize the workspace — bind a profile, write .abap.json, inspect, clear fields, or scaffold AI agent context.

```bash
abap init [options]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--profile=<name>` | Use an existing global profile (created with `abap profile add`). |
| `--system=<name>` | DEPRECATED alias of --profile; will be removed. — **deprecated** |
| `--url=<url>` | SAP system URL (TTY wizard only). |
| `--client=<client>` | SAP client number. |
| `--username=<user>` | SAP username. |
| `--password=<password>` | SAP password (stored in keychain). |
| `--language=<language>` | SAP language. |
| `--insecure` | Skip SSL certificate verification (development only). |
| `--ca=<path>` | Path to a CA certificate (PEM) for SSL verification. |
| `--auth-method=<method>` | Login strategy: basic | cert | browser_sso | oauth_password. |
| `--auth-option=<kv>` | Generic auth option, repeatable as key=value. New auth methods add no Commander options — they read from this bag. |
| `--cert-path=<path>` | X.509 client cert file (PEM) — used with --auth-method=cert. |
| `--cert-key=<path>` | X.509 private key file (PEM) — used with --auth-method=cert. |
| `--cert-ca=<path>` | Optional X.509 client CA override — used with --auth-method=cert. |
| `--cert-passphrase=<pwd>` | Passphrase for .p12 / encrypted key — written to keychain. |
| `--sso-cookie-file=<path>` | SSO cookie jar path — used with --auth-method=browser_sso. |
| `--service-key=<path>` | BTP service key JSON — used with --auth-method=oauth_password. |
| `--tr=<transport>` | Default transport number (written to .abap.json). |
| `--package=<package>` | Default SAP package (written to .abap.json). |
| `--source-dir=<path>` | Base directory for `push --all` / `check --all` (written to .abap.json). |
| `--show-config` | Print the current workspace config (.abap.json) as JSON and exit. |
| `--unset-package` | Remove the `package` key from .abap.json. |
| `--unset-tr` | Remove the `transport` key from .abap.json. |
| `--unset-source-dir` | Remove the `sourceDir` key from .abap.json. |
| `--test-connection` | Probe TLS + auth and report results (implies --test-tls --test-auth). |
| `--test-tls` | Probe the TLS handshake. |
| `--test-auth` | Probe authentication (after TLS). |
| `--agent=<target>` | Scaffold agent context files. One of: copilot | claude | cursor | generic. — enum: `generic`, `copilot`, `claude`, `cursor` |
| `--force` | Overwrite existing files when scaffolding --agent (default: skip). |
| `--yes` | Skip all prompts; fail if required input is missing. |
| `--non-interactive` | Alias of --yes. |
| `--schema` | Print the command parameter schema as JSON and exit (no SAP call). (default `false`) |

### Exclusive groups

- `--unset-package`, `--unset-tr`, `--unset-source-dir`
- `--profile`, `--system`

### Global options

- `--json`

### Examples

```bash
# First-time bind
abap init --profile DEV --tr DEVK900001 --package Z_MY_PACKAGE --yes
# Inspect current config
abap init --show-config
# Scaffold agent context
abap init --agent copilot
```

### Error codes

| Code | Category / exit | Description |
|------|-----------------|-------------|
| `CONFIG_ERROR` | CONFIG_ERROR / 3 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `FILE_EXISTS` | USAGE / 2 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `USAGE` | USAGE / 2 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | USAGE / 2 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |


## `abap pull` _(sap)_

Download ABAP objects from SAP to local files.

```bash
abap pull [options] [object-name]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `<object-name>` | Object name (e.g. ZCL_MY_CLASS). — optional |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--type=<type>` | Object type (CLAS, PROG, INTF, etc.). |
| `--package=<package>` | Download all objects in a package (bounded by --limit). |
| `--limit=<n>` | Batch page size for --package. (default `20`) |
| `--page=<n>` | Batch page number for --package (1-based). (default `1`) |
| `--dir=<path>` | Output directory. (default `"src/"`) |
| `--overwrite` | Replace local file with different content. |
| `--skip-existing` | Skip files that already exist. |
| `--include-tests` | Include testclasses source part. |
| `--include-all-parts` | Include every source-code part. |
| `--textpool` | Also pull textpool files (.texts/.selections/.headings.<lang>.properties). |
| `--remote=<remoteid>` | Pull the object's active version source from a remote system (Version Management). |
| `--tr=<request>` | Pull all objects bound to a transport request (mutually exclusive with object name and --package). |
| `--schema` | Print the command parameter schema as JSON and exit (no SAP call). (default `false`) |

### Exclusive groups

- `--tr`, `<object-name>`
- `--tr`, `--package`

### Global options

- `--json`

### Examples

```bash
# Pull a single class
abap pull ZCL_MY_CLASS --type CLAS
# Pull a whole package
abap pull --package ZPKG --limit 50
# Pull all objects bound to a transport
abap pull --tr DEVK900001
# Pull textpool files alongside the source
abap pull ZCL_MY_CLASS --textpool
```

### Error codes

| Code | Category / exit | Description |
|------|-----------------|-------------|
| `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` | NOT_FOUND / 8 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `DDIC_NOT_SUPPORTED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `OVERWRITE_REQUIRED` | USAGE / 2 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `TRANSPORT_NOT_FOUND` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `PULL_PARTIAL_FAILURE` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | USAGE / 2 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |


## `abap push` _(sap)_

Push local ABAP files to SAP: lock → set source → syntax check → activate → unlock.

```bash
abap push [options] [files...]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `<files>` | Files to push (positional, variadic). — optional |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--all` | Push all .abap files under the scan root (sourceDir or current dir; honours .abapignore). |
| `--tr=<transport>` | Transport number override for unbound objects. |
| `--check-only` | Syntax check only; do not activate. |
| `--no-activate` | Lock + write + skip check + skip activate + unlock. |
| `--dry-run` | Plan only — no mutating ADT calls. |
| `--fail-fast` | Stop at the first failing file (default: --keep-going). |
| `--atomic` | Validate all files first; write nothing if any file fails validation. |
| `--yes` | Confirm in non-interactive mode. |
| `--schema` | Print the command parameter schema as JSON and exit (no SAP call). (default `false`) |

### Exclusive groups

- `--check-only`, `--no-activate`

### Global options

- `--json`

### Examples

```bash
# Push a single file
abap push src/zcl_demo.clas.abap --tr DEVK900001
# Push all files under cwd
abap push --all --tr DEVK900001 --yes
# Syntax check only (no activation)
abap push src/zcl_demo.clas.abap --check-only
```

### Error codes

| Code | Category / exit | Description |
|------|-----------------|-------------|
| `PUSH_FAILED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `NO_TRANSPORT` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `LOCK_FAILED` | LOCKED / 9 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `SYNTAX_ERROR` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `ACTIVATION_FAILED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `FILE_PARSE_ERROR` | USAGE / 2 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |


## `abap check` _(sap)_

Validate ABAP source code (syntax / content / atc).

```bash
abap check [syntax|content|atc] [options]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--variant=<variant>` | ATC check variant (required with `check atc`). |
| `--all` | Check all .abap files under the scan root (sourceDir or current dir). |
| `--changed` | Check only files changed since the SAP version. |
| `--strict` | Treat warnings as failures. |
| `--out=[file]` | Persist raw ATC worklist to a file (only with `check atc`); defaults to .abap/atc/<variant>-<timestamp>.json. |
| `--files=<files...>` | Shortcut: run syntax mode on the given files (equivalent to `abap check syntax <files...>`). |
| `--schema` | Print the command parameter schema as JSON and exit (no SAP call). (default `false`) |

### Global options

- `--json`

### Examples

```bash
# Syntax check
abap check syntax src/zcl_demo.clas.abap
# Local-only validation
abap check content src/zcl_demo.clas.abap
# ATC check with persisted worklist
abap check atc src/zcl_demo.clas.abap --variant Z_ATC_VAR --out
```

### Error codes

| Code | Category / exit | Description |
|------|-----------------|-------------|
| `SYNTAX_ERROR` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | USAGE / 2 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |


## `abap search` _(sap)_

Search for ABAP objects in SAP system

```bash
abap search [options] <query>
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `<query>` | Search query (supports * wildcard). |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--type=<type>` | Filter by object type. |
| `--limit=<n>` | Maximum results per page. (default `20`) |
| `--page=<n>` | Page number (1-based). (default `1`) |
| `--exact` | Exact name match (mutually exclusive with --fuzzy). |
| `--fuzzy` | Substring match (default). |
| `--package=<package>` | Filter by package. |
| `--max=<n>` | Deprecated alias for --limit. — **deprecated** |
| `--page-all` | Fetch all results in one request (cap = --page-all-max × --limit; mutually exclusive with --page). |
| `--page-all-max=<n>` | Page-count cap that sizes the --page-all single request. (default `50`) |
| `--schema` | Print the command parameter schema as JSON and exit (no SAP call). (default `false`) |

### Exclusive groups

- `--exact`, `--fuzzy`
- `--page`, `--page-all`

### Global options

- `--json`

### Examples

```bash
# Filter by type
abap search ZCL_* --type CLAS --limit 50
# Exact name match
abap search ZCL_DEMO --exact
# Fetch all in one request
abap search ZCL_* --page-all
```

### Error codes

| Code | Category / exit | Description |
|------|-----------------|-------------|
| `AMBIGUOUS_OBJECT` | NOT_FOUND / 8 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` | NOT_FOUND / 8 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | USAGE / 2 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |

| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |


## `abap run` _(sap)_

Execute an ABAP class (classrun) or a static method via the bundled runner wrapper; returns stdout + exit code (read-only).

```bash
abap run [options] <class-name>
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `<class-name>` | Target ABAP class name (e.g. ZCL_MY_THING). Local classes with `~` are rejected with LOCAL_CLASS_NOT_RUNNABLE. — pattern: `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_~]{0,29}$` |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--method` | PUBLIC STATIC method name to invoke via ZCL_ABAP_VIBE_RUNNER. When omitted, the class is run via ADT classrun (if_oo_adt_classrun~main). — pattern: `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` |
| `--args` | JSON object of method arguments, mapped to IMPORTING parameters (case-insensitive). Must be a JSON object, not array/null. (default `"{}"`) |
| `--timeout` | Maximum execution time in ms. Wrapper path enforces server-side via cl_abap_runtime; classrun path uses ADT endpoint timeout (~5min) plus CLI-side AbortController fallback. (default `30000`) — min: `100` · max: `600000` |
| `--dry-run` | Plan only — print the request envelope without invoking ADT classrun. (default `false`) |
| `--json` | Emit the unified JSON envelope on stdout; --pretty-json indents. (default `false`) — global |
| `--schema` | Print the command parameter schema as JSON and exit (no SAP call). (default `false`) |

### Exclusive groups

- `--schema`, `<class-name>`

### Global options

- `--json`

### Examples

```bash
# Trigger classrun (no --method)
abap run ZCL_MY_THING
# Invoke a static method with arguments
abap run ZCL_MY_HELPER --method compute --args '{"x":3,"y":5}'
# Dry-run with timeout
abap run ZCL_LONG_RUN --timeout 60000 --dry-run
# Agent integration: JSON envelope
abap run ZCL_FOO --method bar --args '{}' --json
```

### Error codes

| Code | Category / exit | Description |
|------|-----------------|-------------|
| `METHOD_FAILED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `METHOD_NOT_SUPPORTED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `CLASS_NOT_RUNNABLE` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `OBJECT_NOT_ACTIVE` | SAP_ERROR / 6 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `LOCAL_CLASS_NOT_RUNNABLE` | SAP_ERROR / 6 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `TIMEOUT` | SAP_ERROR / 6 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `WRAPPER_NOT_DEPLOYED` | NOT_FOUND / 8 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` | NOT_FOUND / 8 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | USAGE / 2 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |


## `abap select` _(sap)_

Query table data read-only via the bundled ICF /data endpoint (SE16N equivalent): --table ZTAB [--fields ...] [--where ...] [--limit N] [--offset N] [--order-by ...] [--count-only]

```bash
abap select --table <name> [options]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--table=<name>` | Target ABAP table or view name (e.g. ZTAB_FIXTURE). Uppercased and validated against DDIC on SAP side. — required |
| `--fields=<csv>` | Comma-separated field names to project. Omit for all fields (large-object fields STRG/RSTR/LCHR/LRAW excluded, listed in data.excludedFields). |
| `--where=<clause>` | Filter clause: FIELD OP VALUE joined by AND. Ops: = <> > >= < <= LIKE. Strings in single quotes ('' for escape), numbers bare, dates 'YYYYMMDD'. MANDT filter rejected (implicit session client). |
| `--limit=<n>` | Maximum rows returned. SAP fetches limit+1 to detect truncation (data.truncated). (default `100`) — min: `1` · max: `10000` |
| `--offset=<n>` | Row offset for pagination. Deterministic pagination requires --order-by. (default `0`) — min: `0` · max: `100000` |
| `--order-by=<csv>` | Comma-separated FIELD:ASC|DESC pairs, e.g. "ID:ASC,AMOUNT:DESC". |
| `--count-only` | Return only the matching row count (data.count); rows/fields omitted. (default `false`) |
| `--dry-run` | Plan only — print the query envelope without invoking the ICF endpoint. (default `false`) |
| `--json` | Emit the unified JSON envelope on stdout; --pretty-json indents. (default `false`) — global |
| `--schema` | Print the command parameter schema as JSON and exit (no SAP call). (default `false`) |

### Global options

- `--json`

### Examples

```bash
# Basic query with filter and limit
abap select --table ZTAB_FIXTURE --where "STATUS = 'X'" --limit 50
# Projection + sort + pagination
abap select --table ZTAB_FIXTURE --fields "ID,AMOUNT" --order-by "ID:ASC" --limit 20 --offset 40
# Count matching rows
abap select --table ZTAB_FIXTURE --where "AMOUNT > 100" --count-only
# Agent integration: JSON envelope
abap select --table ZTAB_FIXTURE --where "STATUS = 'X'" --limit 50 --json
# Dry-run: zero SAP calls
abap select --table ZTAB_FIXTURE --where "STATUS = 'X'" --dry-run
```

### Error codes

| Code | Category / exit | Description |
|------|-----------------|-------------|
| `TABLE_NOT_FOUND` | NOT_FOUND / 8 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `TABLE_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `INVALID_FIELD` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `INVALID_WHERE` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `OFFSET_EXCEEDED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `QUERY_FAILED` | SAP_ERROR / 6 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | USAGE / 2 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |


## `abap where-used` _(sap)_

Find direct SAP object references (read-only).

```bash
abap where-used [options] <object>
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `<object>` | SAP object name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--type=<type>` | Target object type. — enum: `CLAS`, `INTF`, `PROG`, `FUGR`, `TABL` |
| `--ref-type=<type>` | Filter references by object type. — enum: `CLAS`, `INTF`, `PROG`, `FUGR`, `TABL` |
| `--package=<package>` | Case-insensitive reference package filter. |
| `--limit=<n>` | Maximum returned references (hard cap 500). (default `100`) |
| `--schema` | Print the command parameter schema as JSON and exit (no SAP call). (default `false`) |

### Global options

- `--json`

### Examples

```bash
# Find references to a class
abap where-used ZCL_TARGET --type CLAS
# JSON envelope via the references alias
abap references ZTAB_TARGET --type TABL --ref-type TABL --json
```

### Error codes

| Code | Category / exit | Description |
|------|-----------------|-------------|
| `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` | NOT_FOUND / 8 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `USAGE` | USAGE / 2 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | USAGE / 2 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |


## `abap tcode` _(sap)_

Resolve a transaction code to its configured ABAP entry program (read-only).

```bash
abap tcode <tcode> [--json]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `<tcode>` | SAP transaction code. The lookup returns its configured entry program and screen; parameter-transaction chains are reported as entry_only in this version. — max length: `20` |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--schema` | Print the command parameter schema as JSON and exit (no SAP call). (default `false`) |

### Exclusive groups

- `--schema`, `<tcode>`

### Global options

- `--json`

### Examples

```bash
# Show a transaction code entry program
abap tcode ZMY_TRANSACTION
# Agent integration: structured result
abap tcode SE38 --json
```

### Error codes

| Code | Category / exit | Description |
|------|-----------------|-------------|
| `TCODE_NOT_FOUND` | NOT_FOUND / 8 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `TCODE_NOT_AUTHORIZED` | AUTH_ERROR / 5 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |
| `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | USAGE / 2 | (see docs/commands.md#error-codes) |

## `abap create`

Create a new ABAP source object (CLAS, INTF, PROG, FUGR) and activate it

```bash
abap create <type> <name> [options]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `<type>` | Object type — enum: `CLAS`, `INTF`, `PROG`, `FUGR`, `TABL`, `STRU`, `DOMA`, `DTEL`, `HTTP`, `TRAN` |
| `<name>` | Object name |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--package=<package>` | Target SAP package (required) — required |
| `--description=<desc>` | Object description (required) — required |
| `--tr=<transport>` | Transport number |
| `--no-activate` | Create the object but do not activate it |
| `--template=<template>` | Skeleton template |
| `--no-pull` | Skip the create-then-pull local copy (default: pull after create) |
| `--check-only` | Validate the proposed object without creating it |
| `--audit` | Include the before-checksum (extra SAP round-trip, off by default) |
| `--file=<path>` | abap-file-format DDIC JSON input (required for DOMA/DTEL/TABL/STRU) |
| `--func=<name>` | With FUGR: create a function module (FUGR/FF) inside the existing function group <name> |
| `--schema` | Print the command parameter schema as JSON and exit (no SAP call). (default `false`) |
| `--yes` | Confirm in non-interactive environments. (default `false`) |
| `--non-interactive` | Alias of --yes. (default `false`) |

### Global options

- `--json`

### Examples

```bash
abap create CLAS ZCL_MY_CLASS --package ZPKG --description "desc"
```


## Error Codes

Every error's `error.category` maps 1:1 to its exit code. `UNKNOWN` is the generic fallback for unmapped exceptions (exit `1`). The full authoritative list lives in `src/abap_cli/output/error-codes.ts`; the table below is generated from `EXIT_CODES` and the `CATEGORY_OF_CODE` mapper.

| Category | Exit | Meaning |
|----------|------|---------|
| `UNKNOWN` | `1` | Unmapped exception fallback (exit 1) |
| `USAGE` | `2` | Commander parse error or a USAGE error thrown by the command |
| `CONFIG_ERROR` | `3` | Configuration missing/invalid (run `abap init` / `abap profile add` / `abap profile set`) |
| `TLS_ERROR` | `4` | TLS handshake / certificate failure |
| `AUTH_ERROR` | `5` | 401/403 from SAP (bad credentials) |
| `SAP_ERROR` | `6` | ADT request failed (includes HTTP status) |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `7` | Semantic rejection (e.g. invalid input combination) |
| `NOT_FOUND` | `8` | Object, profile, or transport not found |
| `LOCKED` | `9` | Target object is locked by another user |

### Per-command error code index

Generated from the `errors` array of every command schema (single source of truth). Codes not listed here are reserved for future extensions.

| Code | Category / exit | Used by |
|------|-----------------|---------|
| `ACTIVATION_FAILED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | `abap push`, `abap activate` |
| `AMBIGUOUS_OBJECT` | NOT_FOUND / 8 | `abap search` |
| `AUTH_ERROR` | AUTH_ERROR / 5 | `abap profile` |
| `CLASS_NOT_RUNNABLE` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | `abap run` |
| `CONFIG_ERROR` | CONFIG_ERROR / 3 | `abap init`, `abap profile` |
| `DDIC_NOT_SUPPORTED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | `abap pull` |
| `EXTENSION_LOAD_FAILED` | CONFIG_ERROR / 3 | `abap extensions` |
| `EXTENSION_VALIDATION_FAILED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | `abap extensions` |
| `FILE_EXISTS` | USAGE / 2 | `abap init` |
| `FILE_PARSE_ERROR` | USAGE / 2 | `abap push` |
| `FORCE_BYPASSED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | `abap extension` |
| `ICF_CHECK_DEGRADED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | `abap extension` |
| `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | USAGE / 2 | `abap init`, `abap pull`, `abap check`, `abap search`, `abap status`, `abap diff`, `abap transport`, `abap profile`, `abap run`, `abap select`, `abap where-used`, `abap tcode` |
| `INVALID_FIELD` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | `abap select` |
| `INVALID_WHERE` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | `abap select` |
| `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | `abap select` |
| `LOCAL_CLASS_NOT_RUNNABLE` | SAP_ERROR / 6 | `abap run` |
| `LOCK_FAILED` | LOCKED / 9 | `abap push` |
| `METHOD_FAILED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | `abap run` |
| `METHOD_NOT_SUPPORTED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | `abap run` |
| `NO_TRANSPORT` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | `abap push`, `abap extension` |
| `OBJECT_NOT_ACTIVE` | SAP_ERROR / 6 | `abap run` |
| `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` | NOT_FOUND / 8 | `abap pull`, `abap search`, `abap inspect`, `abap activate`, `abap run`, `abap where-used` |
| `OFFSET_EXCEEDED` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | `abap select` |
| `OVERWRITE_REQUIRED` | USAGE / 2 | `abap pull` |
| `PASSWORD_EXPORT` | VALIDATION_ERROR / 7 | `abap profile` |
